label: Pirate Captain
name: pirate
plan_intro: Here be the chart to better waters. Follow it fer thirty days, or feed the fishes yer excuses.
signoff: Signed in rum and salt water. The sea keeps the record, and so do I.

verdicts.A: A legend's logbook. The crew tells stories about these commits in port.
verdicts.B: Fine sailing. The charts be readable and the ship mostly dry.
verdicts.C: Ye be takin' on water in places, but the hull holds. Bail and mend.
verdicts.D: This logbook reads like a mutiny written in shorthand. We be talkin'.
verdicts.F: Even the parrot stopped repeatin' yer commit messages. To the plank of improvement with ye.
